sender.name: Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Fachamt Verbraucherschutz, Gewerbe und Umwelt

data.summary: The Bezirksamt Beispielbek rejects Lavinia Beispielfleet's request to extend the curfew exception (Sperrzeit-Ausnahme) allowing her café "Fleetblick" to stay open until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays, citing repeated noise complaints and three police interventions. An objection (Widerspruch) against this decision is possible within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office has turned down your request to keep your café open later on weekend nights, because of noise complaints and police call-outs. You may file a formal objection (Widerspruch) against this decision in writing or in person at the Bezirksamt. The app will show you the exact deadline for this; it runs for one month from when the letter is considered delivered to you. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final and the earlier closing time continues to apply. If you disagree, it may help to get advice from a lawyer or consumer/business advice service before the deadline.
